title: Console UI: add Optimization Suggestions (beta) view behind feature flag
author: Nora Ahmed
description: Summary: Implements the new Console page for Redwood Optimize → Optimization suggestions (beta). This is the list + details experience for batching/caching suggestions only. The UI is gated behind a feature flag (optimize_suggestions_beta) and a read permission (optimize:suggestions:read). The page presents estimated savings ($/day + %) and estimated latency deltas (p50/p95), plus a Low/Medium/High risk badge with explanatory copy. Includes list/table layout with filtering/sorting, pagination, a details drawer with assumptions + guardrails, and complete empty/error states. Context: This is the frontend half of the beta Suggestions experience described in PM-842 / ENG-19358. API contract work landed separately (see pr-21934). Risk badge component is shared and comes from pr-21983. Telemetry events are intentionally limited here to basic page-view instrumentation; full funnel events are tracked in pr-22011. Feature gating: (1) Feature flag: optimize_suggestions_beta (org-scoped, remote-config driven). (2) Permission: optimize:suggestions:read (RBAC; UI hides nav + blocks route when missing). When the feature flag is off: the navigation entry is hidden and direct-route access redirects to /optimize (with a toast). When permission is missing: render AccessDenied with a link to internal docs for requesting access (kept behind isInternal guard in prod builds). UX overview: Entry point is Optimize → Suggestions. Default view is a table grouped by Route + Model (not hard-grouped, but those are primary columns). Columns: Suggestion (type: batching/caching), Estimated savings (primary metric, sortable), Risk (badge + tooltip), Confidence (chip), Updated (stale indicator + timestamp). Filters: Model, Route, Region, Suggestion type (Batching / Caching), Risk (Low/Med/High), and a toggle to show dismissed (beta-only; hidden unless ?debugSuggestions=1). Sorting: savings desc (default), savings asc, risk, updated_at. Pagination: server-driven cursor pagination; table supports page size 25/50 (default 25). Details drawer: Clicking a row opens a right-side drawer with: (a) What we recommend (human-readable title), (b) Why we recommend this (top signals, e.g., concurrency, cache hit rate, sequence length distribution), (c) Estimated impact (savings + latency delta with confidence band), (d) Risk & guardrails (explain that risk is performance/reliability risk; not security risk), (e) How to enable (deep links to batching/caching config pages + docs). Drawer also surfaces suggestion_id and stale_as_of timestamp for support/debug. Empty + error states: Added 4 distinct empty states per design spec: No suggestions yet (but telemetry present) → show onboarding text + links; Insufficient telemetry → show requirements (min window + signals) and link to telemetry setup; Feature not enabled → show request access CTA (beta); API error → show retry and status text, plus a small disclosure for request id. Also added skeleton loading for initial fetch and drawer fetch. Implementation details: New route: /optimize/suggestions (lazy-loaded bundle). Data layer: console-web uses the typed REST client; added OptimizeSuggestionsClient with getSuggestions({ filters, sort, cursor, limit }). Normalizes response into table rows; uses suggestion_id as the stable key. State management: useUrlState hook for filters/sort/pagination so the view is shareable and persists across reloads; drawer open state uses suggestion_id in querystring (?sid=...). Accessibility: Table supports keyboard row focus + Enter to open drawer; drawer traps focus; risk badge tooltips are keyboard accessible. Verified color contrast in dark mode for risk badges (relies on shared component from pr-21983). Minimal illustrative snippet (not a full diff): Added route registration: routes.ts: registerRoute({ path: '/optimize/suggestions', featureFlag: 'optimize_suggestions_beta', permission: 'optimize:suggestions:read', component: lazy(() => import('./pages/OptimizeSuggestions')) }); Added URL state for filters: const { state, setState } = useUrlState(schema, { sort: 'savings_desc', limit: 25 }); Testing: Unit tests for filter serialization + URL state roundtrip (8 cases) and for rendering each empty state given mocked API responses. Added mocked API fixtures for: insufficient_telemetry, no_suggestions, permission_denied, stale_suggestions. Basic Playwright smoke (existing suite) updated to ensure the route doesn’t register when flag is off (guards nav item). Manual QA steps (recommended): 1) With flag OFF: confirm nav item hidden; direct hit /optimize/suggestions redirects. 2) With flag ON + no permission: AccessDenied renders; no API call. 3) With flag ON + permission: table loads; filters update URL; pagination works. 4) Open drawer: verify deep links, stale timestamp, tooltip copy. 5) Simulate API 500: error state shows retry and request id. Screenshots: Attached in PR: (a) Default list view with filters, (b) Details drawer with assumptions + guardrails section, (c) Insufficient telemetry empty state, (d) Access denied state. Notes / follow-ups: - This PR intentionally does not emit expand/dismiss/apply funnel events; see pr-22011 / ENG-19402. - Copy for risk tooltips is pulled from shared strings; final review on wording tracked in DES-640. - Dismiss action is not implemented in beta UI (non-goal); a debug-only toggle exists for internal testing of dismissed rows but is not visible to customers. - Need to verify RBAC permission name matches backend enforcement once pr-22026 lands in prod (currently behind the same beta flag). Release/rollout: Safe to merge behind flag. Default flag state remains OFF in all envs except staging. Beta enablement via internal runbook (how-to-enable-suggestions-beta-feature-flag). Review notes: Dylan requested we avoid fetching suggestions when AccessDenied is known; addressed by moving permission check earlier in route guard. Tessa requested clearer distinction that “risk” is performance/reliability, not security; updated tooltip + drawer header accordingly. Chloe requested we handle cursor pagination consistently when filters change; fixed by resetting cursor on filter/sort changes. CI: web-console lint/test, typecheck, and Playwright smoke passed. One initial flake in Playwright (timing on drawer animation) was fixed by waiting on drawer heading instead of CSS transition end. Merge: Squash merged to main.
release_notes: Console: Added Optimization suggestions (beta) page (feature-flagged) with savings/latency estimates, risk badges, filters/sorting, and a details drawer for batching/caching recommendations.
